issue_context.title: Try to speed up controller/nodelifecycle/scheduler unit tests
issue_context.body:
`k8s.io/kubernetes/pkg/controller/nodelifecycle/scheduler` tests are using real time delays in `pkg/controller/nodelifecycle/scheduler/timed_workers_test.go`. Example: https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/blob/4b3d6369dd204c38959d4f508c7a3a3d3d81eb35/pkg/controller/nodelifecycle/scheduler/timed_workers_test.go#L64-L75 

Need to check whether they can be re-written to use fake clock instead.

Related to: #98486

/area test
/sig node
